hooks.command: PY=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); [ -n "$PY" ] || { echo 'python3 or python is required for render hook' >&2; exit 2; }; "$PY" -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; root=next((p for p in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents) if (p/'.git').is_dir() or (p/'.git').is_file()),None); hook=root/'scripts'/'render_hook.py' if root else None; ok=hook is not None and hook.is_file(); print('render hook not found in current worktree',file=sys.stderr) if not ok else None; sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,str(hook)]) if ok else 2)"
hooks.commandWindows: python -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; root=next((p for p in (Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents) if (p/'.git').is_dir() or (p/'.git').is_file()),None); hook=root/'scripts'/'render_hook.py' if root else None; ok=hook is not None and hook.is_file(); print('render hook not found in current worktree',file=sys.stderr) if not ok else None; sys.exit(subprocess.call([sys.executable,str(hook)]) if ok else 2)"
